ifelse(reverse[, d], 1, 2)     x[, "B", d] <- ifelse(reverse[, d], 2, 1)   }   x } make_law <- function(id, reverse, masses) {   postrank_mdomain_input(     make_states(reverse, paste0(id, "-", seq_len(nrow(reverse)))),     targets = targets,     provenance = list(input_id = id, law_id = id, proper_law = TRUE,       joint_generation = "Complete finite support authored in this article.", coincident = make_law("coincident",     rbind(c(FALSE, FALSE), c(TRUE, TRUE)), c("9/10", "1/10")),   disjoint = make_law("disjoint",     rbind(c(FALSE, FALSE), c(TRUE, FALSE), c(FALSE, TRUE)),     c("8/10", "1/10", "1/10"))) policy <- postrank_mdomain_decision(tau = "1/4", t = "0", alpha = "3/20") columns <- list(withhold = c(A = 1L, B = 1L),   A_above_B = c(A = 1L, B = 2L), B_above_A = c(A = 2L, B = 1L)) families <- lapply(laws, postrank_mdomain_family,   columns = list(one = columns, two = columns), max_actions = 9L) fits <- lapply(names(laws), function(id)   postrank_mdomain_solve(laws[[id]], families[[id]], policy, max_actions = 9L)) names(fits) <- names(laws)  column_label <- function(g) {   if (g[1L] == g[2L]) "withhold" else     if (g[1L] < g[2L]) "A above B" else "B above A" } candidate_display <- function(fit) {   tab <- fit$candidate_table   actions <- fit$solution$actions[tab$action_id]   data.frame(     one = vapply(actions, function(g) tab$feasible_for_represented_measure, optimal = tab$optimal,     row.names = NULL) } knitr::kable(candidate_display(fits$coincident),   caption = "All nine candidates: coincident reversals") knitr::kable(candidate_display(fits$disjoint),   caption = "All nine candidates: disjoint reversals") dual <- matrix(c(1L, 2L, 1L, 2L), 2L,   dimnames = list(units, domains)) dual_evaluations <- lapply(laws, postrank_mdomain_evaluate,   grades = dual, decision = policy) knitr::kable(do.call(rbind, lapply(names(laws), function(id) {   e <- dual_evaluations[[id]]   data.frame(law = id, error_one = e$domain_table$EF_exact[1L],     error_two = e$domain_table$EF_exact[2L], risk = e$risk_exact,     joint_probability = e$J_exact,     feasible = e$feasible_for_represented_measure) })), caption = "The same dual card under the two joint laws") stopifnot(all(vapply(dual_evaluations,   function(e) all(e$domain_table$EF_exact == "1/10"), TRUE))) optima <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(fits), function(id) {   fit <- fits[[id]]   tab <- candidate_display(fit)   data.frame(law = id, tab[tab$optimal, ], row.names = NULL) })) knitr::kable(optima, caption = "The complete optimizer sets in the declared banks") stopifnot(fits$coincident$optimizer_count == 1L,   fits$disjoint$optimizer_count == 2L,   fits$coincident$evaluation$risk_exact == "1/10",   fits$disjoint$evaluation$risk_exact == "7/40",   all(vapply(fits, function(f) f$search_scope$examined_actions == 9L, TRUE))) separable_policy <- postrank_mdomain_decision(tau = "1/4", t = NULL) separate_fits <- lapply(names(laws), function(id)   postrank_mdomain_solve(laws[[id]], families[[id]], separable_policy,     max_actions = 9L)) knitr::kable(data.frame(law = names(laws),   optimum_risk = vapply(separate_fits, function(f) f$evaluation$risk_exact, ""),   optimizer_count = vapply(separate_fits, `[[`, 1L, "optimizer_count"))) stopifnot(all(vapply(separate_fits, code: simulate_chain <- function(n) {   z <- logical(n)   z[1L] <- stats::runif(1) < 1/5   for (i in 2:n)     z[i] <- if (z[i - 1L]) stats::runif(1) >= 2/5 else stats::runif(1) < 1/10   z } set.seed(1202) chains <- list(chain_A = simulate_chain(24L), chain_B = simulate_chain(31L)) z <- unlist(chains, use.names = FALSE) history <- data.frame(source_index = seq_along(z),   chain_id = rep(names(chains), lengths(chains)),   iteration_id = unlist(lapply(chains, seq_along), use.names = FALSE)) history_input <- postrank_mdomain_input(   make_states(cbind(z, z), paste0("markov-", seq_along(z))), targets = targets,   provenance = list(input_id = "tiny-markov-history", law_id = "tiny-markov-law",     proper_law = TRUE,     joint_generation = "Both domains use the same synthetic binary chain state.",     retention = list(warmup_removed = 0L, thinning = 1L),     sampling_assumptions = list(sampler = "Two-state Markov transition simulator.",       chain_details = "Lengths 24 and 31; stationary initial draws; seed 1202.",       target_assertion = "Stationary reversal probability 1/5 by the specified transitions.")),   representation = "mcmc_equal_weight_draws", state_origin = history) fixed_grades <- matrix(c(1L, 2L, 1L, 2L), 2L,   dimnames = list(units, domains)) assessment <- postrank_mdomain_assess(history_input, fixed_grades, policy,   method = "mcmc", batch_size = 10L,   design = list(role = "synthetic_method_demonstration")) chain_table <- assessment$native$chain_table knitr::kable(chain_table[chain_table$event_id == "joint-union",   c("chain_id", "n_retained", "hit_count", "rate", "max_zero_run",     "partial_batch_count")], digits = 3) batch_table <- assessment$native$batch_table knitr::kable(batch_table[batch_table$event_id == "joint-union" & batch_table$partial,   c("chain_id", "batch_id", "n_retained", "hit_count", "rate", "partial")],   caption = "Final partial batches remain in the diagnostic record", digits = 3) assessment$assurance[c("certificate_basis", "numerical_guarantee",   "convergence_established", "independence_established")] #> $certificate_basis #> [1] "empirical_diagnostic" #>  #> $numerical_guarantee #> [1] FALSE #>  #> $convergence_established #> [1] FALSE #>  #> $independence_established #> [1] FALSE stopifnot(!assessment$joint_certificate,   !assessment$assurance$numerical_guarantee,   identical(assessment$native$histories$chain_id, history$chain_id))
